headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Do not default to bold, mix weights.

colors.rules: No gradients for backgrounds. Use flat colors. Use the primary accent (#002FA7) strictly for primary CTA buttons and important links.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px sharp borders. Expose the structural grid where possible (Technical Look).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalistic. Use sharp 1px offset borders or very diffuse shadows. No muddy gray shadows.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px bottom border-border.
surfaces.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and drop-shadow.

components.buttons: Sharp corners or very slight rounding (rounded-sm). Solid fill for primary, 1px border for secondary. Strong hover states with color shifts.
components.cards: Use raw div elements for layout freedom rather than Shadcn cards. 1px borders. Add generous padding (p-8 or p-12).
components.navigation: Fixed header with backdrop-blur. Logo left, links center, Sign in / Register right.
components.pricing_card: High contrast. Deep charcoal background (#0A0A0A) for the primary pricing tier if featured, white text. Large price typography.

layouts.hero: Massive typography (text-5xl to text-6xl+). Asymmetrical layout. High contrast text.
layouts.feature_tour: Bento Grid (Mode A: 'Tetris' Grid). Asymmetrical, mixing wide, tall, and square cells. Gap-8 to gap-12.
layouts.industry_templates: Overlapping or masonry grid layout with heavy imagery and stark text overlays.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 to py-32 for sections.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (color shift + slight transform).
motion.entrance: Framer motion for staggered fade-in and slide-up on scroll.
motion.parallax: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling if possible. Subtle parallax on hero image.

hero_background.description: Two workers managing inventory in a spacious warehouse aisle. Used for the Hero section to establish operations context.

apparel_industry.description: Apparel factory line. Used for Industry Templates section.

pharma_industry.description: Pharmaceutical lab worker. Used for Industry Templates section.

food_production.description: Food production line. Used for Industry Templates section.

fmcg_industry.description: Generic warehouse operations. Used for FMCG or general template.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='pricing-subscribe-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-conversion marketing page in /app/frontend/src/App.js (or relevant entry point).
Implement Framer Motion for scroll animations.
Do not apply global transitions (e.g., transition: all).
Include the header with 'Sign in' (/login) and 'Start free trial' (/register).
Build the Feature Tour as a Bento grid.
Create a bold Pricing section highlighting '$10/user/month' and '14-day free trial'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Create distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical layouts with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for floating navs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays.
